misprints.note: Påkomma: printed with a circumflex where an acute belongs.
Påkänning: the mark over α is an acute stroke, not a rough breathing.
Påsk: no full stop after the abbreviation p.
Påstöt: full stop where a comma belongs.

uncertain.note: The scan cuts off the right edge of the column, so the final ν of συλλαβεῖν and the stop after ἐπιγίγνεσθαι are not visible. Both are supplied.
The τ looks broken, almost like ι. Read as τι.

uncertain.text: παρέχει μοί τι. ὀκνῶ ποιεῖν τι.
uncertain.note: The accents fall on the cut between the two image bands. Read from the fragments left at the bottom of band 0.
The mark over the article looks like a smooth breathing, not a rough one. It may be a worn ἡ; if ἠ is right, it is a misprint for ἡ.
The image is a 28x26 px speck of dust with no text, so the file was emptied. The old text '~ 1)' was spurious.
